content.text: an oral PDE inhibitor is USU first-line; nitrates + PDE5 inhibitors: dangerous, contraindicated; alpha-blockers: start PDE5 inhibitors cautiously at lower doses (hypotension); wait ≥ 4 h after the alpha-blocker; AEs: flushing, visual changes, hearing loss, dyspepsia, headache; sildenafil and vardenafil: blue haze; tadalafil: myalgias.

50 mg prn ~1 h before sex (30 min to 4 h); max once/day; ↑ to 100 mg max or ↓ to 25 mg. CI: nitric oxide donors (organic nitrates or nitrites) in any form, regularly or intermittently; CI: GC stimulators such as riociguat. Erection > 4 h: seek immediate help (untreated priapism → tissue damage, permanent loss of potency). Sudden vision loss in one or both eyes (possible NAION): stop all PDE5 inhibitors and seek care. Sudden ↓ or loss of hearing: stop and seek prompt care. Ritonavir ↑ sildenafil levels substantially (11-fold AUC). Combos w other PDE5 inhibitors (incl Revatio) or other ED tx: ⍉ recommended (may further ↓ BP).
